description: Connect (or re-connect) a Gmail account. Opens Google sign-in in the user's browser on this computer and returns immediately with the sign-in link; the account becomes available once the user approves in the browser. If a different Google account signs in than the email given, nothing is saved. Set calendar=true to also allow Google Calendar. Afterwards call list_accounts to confirm. (IMAP mailboxes are added with the CLI: gmail-mcp-multi add-imap.)

alias.description: Short friendly name for the account, e.g. "work", "personal", "urbanstickers".

calendar.description: Also request Google Calendar access (read; plus create events in full mode).

email.description: The Gmail address. Strongly recommended: sign-ins from any other Google account are rejected.

mode.description: Permissions to request from Google. Defaults to the server mode. Cannot exceed the server mode.

name: authenticate
title: Connect a Gmail account
